```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

xcell = read.csv("./input/xcell_cr_linear_regression_Outputs_CytoCNV.csv",row.names = 1)
pseudo = read.csv("./input/all_pseudobulk_cr_linear_regression_Outputs_CytoCNV.csv",row.names = 1)

# ============================================================
# SETTINGS
# ============================================================
TUMOR_TYPE       <- "LUAD"
CD8_PATTERN      <- "CD8"
OUT_DIR          <- "./"
chr_line_size    <- 0.3
center_line_size <- 0.15

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: Filter raw data and find common cytobands
#   Do this BEFORE factoring so the shared levels are identical
# ============================================================
pseudo_raw <- pseudo %>%
  filter(TumorType == TUMOR_TYPE,
         grepl(CD8_PATTERN, CellType, ignore.case = TRUE))

xcell_raw <- xcell %>%
  filter(TumorType == TUMOR_TYPE,
         grepl(CD8_PATTERN, CellType, ignore.case = TRUE))

# common cytobands between the two datasets
com_cyto <- intersect(pseudo_raw$Cytoband, xcell_raw$Cytoband)
message(length(com_cyto), " common cytobands found.")

# keep only common cytobands in both
pseudo_raw <- pseudo_raw %>% filter(Cytoband %in% com_cyto)
xcell_raw  <- xcell_raw  %>% filter(Cytoband %in% com_cyto)

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: prep_data — sort, compute signedlogP, factor
#   shared_levels ensures identical Cytoband factor order
# ============================================================
prep_data <- function(df, shared_levels) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      chr_num   = case_when(
        as.character(Chromosome) == "X" ~ 23L,
        as.character(Chromosome) == "Y" ~ 24L,
        TRUE ~ as.integer(as.character(Chromosome))
      ),
      arm_num   = ifelse(Arm == "p", 0L, 1L),
      band_val  = as.numeric(
        gsub("^[pq]", "", gsub("^[0-9XY]+", "", Cytoband))
      ),
      band_sort = ifelse(Arm == "p", -band_val, band_val)
    ) %>%
    arrange(chr_num, arm_num, band_sort) %>%
    mutate(
      signedlogP = X.signedlog.P.adj. * cnv_status,
      cnv_status = ifelse(cnv_status > 0, "Gain", "Loss"),
      Chromosome = factor(
        gsub("Chr", "", as.character(Chromosome)),
        levels = c(as.character(1:22), "X", "Y")
      ),
      ChrArm   = factor(ChrArm,   levels = unique(ChrArm)),
      # use shared_levels so all three plots have identical x-axis
      Cytoband = factor(Cytoband, levels = shared_levels)
    )
}

# derive the canonical genomic order from pseudo (or xcell — same after filter)
cyto_order <- pseudo_raw %>%
  mutate(
    chr_num   = case_when(
      as.character(Chromosome) == "X" ~ 23L,
      as.character(Chromosome) == "Y" ~ 24L,
      TRUE ~ as.integer(as.character(Chromosome))
    ),
    arm_num   = ifelse(Arm == "p", 0L, 1L),
    band_val  = as.numeric(
      gsub("^[pq]", "", gsub("^[0-9XY]+", "", Cytoband))
    ),
    band_sort = ifelse(Arm == "p", -band_val, band_val)
  ) %>%
  arrange(chr_num, arm_num, band_sort) %>%
  pull(Cytoband) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique()

pseudo_df <- prep_data(pseudo_raw, cyto_order)
xcell_df  <- prep_data(xcell_raw,  cyto_order)

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: Spot product  (pseudo × xcell, already aligned)
# ============================================================
spot_df <- pseudo_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Cytoband, Chromosome, Arm, ChrArm,
                chr_num, arm_num, band_sort,
                signedlogP_pseudo = signedlogP) %>%
  left_join(
    xcell_df %>% dplyr::select(Cytoband, signedlogP_xcell = signedlogP),
    by = "Cytoband"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    signedlogP = signedlogP_pseudo * signedlogP_xcell,
    cnv_status = ifelse(signedlogP >= 0, "Gain", "Loss"),
    Cytoband   = factor(Cytoband, levels = cyto_order)
  )

# ============================================================
# STEP 4: Plot function  (Cytoband level only)
# ============================================================
plot_genome <- function(df,
                        stat_col    = "signedlogP",
                        signif      = 2,
                        sec_signif  = 1,
                        plottitle   = "",
                        y_label = "Signed -log10(P.adj)", 
                        color_gain  = "#ad0224",
                        color_loss  = "#020dad",
                        product_plot = F) {

  df <- df[!is.na(df$Chromosome) & !is.na(df[[stat_col]]), ]

  # chromosome boundary (last cytoband per chr)
  chr.cut <- df %>%
    group_by(Ref = Chromosome) %>%
    summarise(vals = last(Cytoband), .groups = "drop") %>%
    na.omit()

  # centromere line (last cytoband of each p-arm)
  arm.cut <- df %>%
    group_by(Ref = ChrArm) %>%
    summarise(vals = last(Cytoband), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      vals = ifelse(grepl("q", Ref), NA, as.character(vals)),
      Ref  = gsub("p|q", "", Ref)
    ) %>%
    filter(!duplicated(Ref), !is.na(vals))

  # chromosome number label position (middle cytoband)
  chr.mid <- df %>%
    group_by(Ref = Chromosome) %>%
    filter(row_number() == ceiling(n() / 2)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Ref, vals = Cytoband)

  ymax <- max(ceiling(max(abs(df[[stat_col]]), na.rm = TRUE)), 3)

  x <- rlang::sym("Cytoband")
  y <- rlang::sym(stat_col)

  color_vals <- scales::alpha(
    c("Gain" = color_gain, "Loss" = color_loss), 0.65
  )

  # zero-padding so geom_area renders both fill colours cleanly
  df_pad  <- df %>%
    mutate(!!stat_col := 0,
           cnv_status = ifelse(cnv_status == "Gain", "Loss", "Gain"))
  df_full <- bind_rows(df, df_pad)
  
  if(product_plot){
    df_full$cnv_status = gsub("Gain","concordant",df_full$cnv_status)
    df_full$cnv_status = gsub("Loss","discordant",df_full$cnv_status)
    color_vals <- scales::alpha( 
      c("concordant" = color_gain, "discordant" = color_loss), 0.65)
   }
  
  ggplot(df_full) +
    geom_area(aes(x = !!x, y = !!y,
                  group = cnv_status, fill = cnv_status)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_vals) +
    ylim(-ymax, ymax) +
    labs(title = plottitle, y = y_label) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(  
            axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
            legend.text =  element_text(size = 15),
            legend.direction = "horizontal",  
            legend.box ="vertical",
            legend.title =  element_blank(),
            axis.title.y =  element_text(size = 18.5),
            axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 15,face = "bold"),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 25,hjust = 0.5),
            legend.position = c(0.90, 0.90)
            ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = arm.cut$vals,
               linetype = "dotted",   color = "#8F8F8F",
               linewidth = center_line_size) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = chr.cut$vals,
               linetype = "longdash", color = "#8F8F8F",
               linewidth = chr_line_size) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-signif,     signif),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-sec_signif, sec_signif),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(data = chr.mid,
              aes(x = vals, y = -ymax, label = Ref, hjust = 0, vjust = 0),
              angle = 0, size = 6.5, inherit.aes = FALSE)
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: Build panels and save
# ============================================================
p_pseudo <- plot_genome(
  pseudo_df,
  plottitle  = "pseudo bulk |  LUAD  |  CD8+T",
 # color_gain = "#d4511a", color_loss = "#019050"
  color_gain = "#be3a0e", color_loss = "#0184a0"
)

p_xcell <- plot_genome(
  xcell_df,
  plottitle  = "xcell  |  LUAD  |  CD8+T",
  color_gain = "#ad0224", color_loss = "#020dad"
)


p_spot <- plot_genome(
  spot_df,
  plottitle  = "spot product (pseudo × xcell)  |  LUAD  |  CD8+T",
  y_label = "product of Signed -log10(P.adj)",
  color_gain = "grey30",   # concordant  → green
  color_loss = "grey85",    # discordant  → red
  product_plot = T
)

#pdf(file.path(OUT_DIR, "CD8_LUAD_cytoband.pdf"), height = 12, width = 29)
print(p_pseudo / p_xcell / p_spot)
#dev.off()

#message("Done. PDF saved to ", OUT_DIR, "CD8_LUAD_cytoband.pdf")
```

```{r}
permutation_test <- function(x, y, n = 1000, low_rvalue_cut = 0) {
  set.seed(12345)
  index <-  abs(y) > low_rvalue_cut
  
  x <- x[index]
  y <- y[index]

  statisc_fn <- function(x, y) cor(x, y,method = "spearman") #,use = "pairise.complete.obs")
  statisc <- statisc_fn(x, y)

  permutation_statisc <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    permutation_statisc[i] <- statisc_fn(x, sample(y, length(y)))
  }

  p <- sum(statisc < permutation_statisc) / n

  gg_df <- data.frame(statisc = permutation_statisc)
  p1 <- ggplot(gg_df, aes(x = statisc)) +
    geom_density() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = statisc, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_minimal() +
    annotate("text", label = paste0("p value: ", round(p, 3)),
             x = 0.8 * statisc, y = 15, size = 5) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Pearson\n"))

  return(list(plot = p1, statistic = statisc, p_value = p))
}
res <- permutation_test(x = pseudo_df$signedlogP, y= xcell_df$signedlogP, n = 1000,low_rvalue_cut = -log10(0.2)  )
res$plot
res$statistic
res$p_value
```
